name: Father's Road (Phụ Lộ)

bonuses.effect: The Rider Comes In (Kỵ Tự Lai)
bonuses.rule: after you block, the attacker gains an Earth slow stack (Earth debuff, 8 s), and your next counter-cut (Answering Cut) deals 25 % more damage to a slowed foe.

story: Both made from what was left on the road below Viên Đề Hạp in 1100: her father's sabre and his wagon. She wears them on every caravan.
